introHtml: Cotton toiletry bags offer a soft, natural feel that synthetic materials can't match, making them a preferred choice for eco-conscious corporate gifts or retail giveaways. The fabric absorbs screen printing and embroidery beautifully, ensuring your logo stands out with crisp detail. Whether you're outfitting a sales team with travel-ready kits or creating branded welcome bags for an event, cotton provides a durable, washable surface that customers appreciate.
